_note: Intersection corpus for MUSE-26: one defect per invalid document, each mutated from the valid base clip-room.nil.json. errorContains is a literal substring of the refusal. level pins WHERE it refuses: document-level throws in validateScene, field-level passes validation and throws in compileSceneField's target check. Invalid files live in ../invalid/ but are NOT in the MUSE-13 manifest (its runner only calls validateScene; the field-level cases pass validation by design) nor in the MUSE-21 manifest (different operation). Valid documents pin where clipping differs from carving: full removal, no-op clips, shared targets, document-order independence, tangent boundary, and the normal-agreement case the sign exists for.
